root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: annot->getDict()->ref(after constructing the standalone field owner) > annot->getDict()->ref(before constructing the standalone field owner)
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When Page::loadStandaloneFields() constructs the new owning Object that will be moved into Form::createFieldFromDict(), it must increment the shared annotation dictionary refcount immediately. The vulnerable path constructs that owner with Object(annot->getDict()) and leaves annot->getDict()->ref unchanged at the root-cause operation itself.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing mechanism is not that the standalone-field path eventually raises the refcount somewhere else; FormWidget::FormWidget later contributes its own copy on both versions. The root obligation is earlier and narrower: the specific owner created at Page::loadStandaloneFields() must itself bump the shared Dict refcount when it is constructed. The fixed program does this with annot->getAnnotObj().copy(); the vulnerable program does not.

nodes.state: After the tracked standalone field has already released the shared dictionary during page teardown, ObjectStream cleanup later reaches Object::free() on the same dict pointer and is about to execute the ASan-reported stale dict->decRef().

At the end of the tracked standalone field destructor, obj.getDict()->ref == 1. The immediately following destruction of FormField::obj therefore drops the last recorded owner to zero and frees the shared dictionary during page teardown.

edges.relation: The same shared Dict* selected at the root-cause owner-construction site is retained in FormField::obj, so the undercounted dictionary created there is the one later released during standalone field teardown.
Page teardown frees the shared dictionary through the tracked standalone field before the stale ObjectStream cached owner later reuses the same pointer in Object::free().
